about.lead: Bartek, 22. Graphic designer and developer from Łódź, Poland.
about.p1: I'm a graphic and layout designer with 5 years of professional experience working with clients worldwide — advertising campaigns, editorial work, and social media. In high school I served as editor-in-chief of the school magazine.
about.p2: I'm also a developer. Currently a 2nd-year Computer Science student at Lodz University of Technology, comfortable across many stacks: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, C++, SQL, and more.
about.p3: Outside of work I produce music in FL Studio and Ableton. I hold a Cambridge C2 English certificate (206/210).
